action.objective: Capture the b5 pawn with the bishop and complete development by castling, converting the exact best evidence into a win.
action.rationale: a4b5 is the only commit_ready move and carries the strongest exact evidence (score 136, depth 3, PV Bxb5 cxb5 O-O). It was verified complete for immediate mates and tactical refutation not_found. move_facts confirm it wins the b5 pawn; cxb5 recapture is available but the broad line with O-O keeps White ahead on the exact bound. d5f6 at same depth is only upper-bound 136 with real value possibly much worse, so a4b5 is preferred.
